resources.string: The dot beside the object name shows both orbit colors: above and below the horizon.
Photo and panorama legends now use split-color dots instead of lines.
Dots scale with the text and their outlines match the lettering, including in exported images.
Types ordered by object count, alphabetical sorting options and clearer object controls.
Steadier reference labels and Nadir at −90°, opposite Zenith.
Improved moon motion, selected-object close approaches and explicit weather-loading status.
